goal_template: Eventually get <GOAL>, though unable to state it cleanly at first.
opening_intent: Opens with backstory and circles the actual need without naming it directly.
followup_intents: misunderstands one agent question and answers a different one
asks the agent to repeat or rephrase at least once
mixes up a detail given earlier and corrects it later
drifts onto a tangent mid-task and needs steering back
success_criteria: the agent pinned down the real need despite the noise
the corrected detail, not the original wrong one, is what got confirmed
quirks: gives dates and numbers in a roundabout, relative way
